This is a constant pet peeve for me about this site. Proof requires more evidence than this man gave. Although we can't verify the numbers that went into the black box, that is not proof their results are wrong. Although the exit polls don't match the reported results, that is not proof they are manipulated. Although the deviation between exit polls and reported results is outside a reasonable threshold, that is not proof of fraud. All these points do raise suspicion, and they add support to the claim that something isn't right with the results, but it is not proof of anything.

Proof would be looking into the software and finding a vote manipulation subroutine. Proof would be a vote of only one person, and them seeing results that don't match how they voted. Proof would be exit polling 100% of voters, somehow guaranteeing that they didn't lie on the poll, and then seeing a mismatch between that and the reported results.

What we have here is cause for suspicion, but not proof of anything.
